repo.name: EverNoise
repo.description: Official EverNoise releases from Eric Niemeyer. Free, offline, continuous noise.

apps.description:
Your sound. All night.

EverNoise generates continuous noise on your device, with no looping sound files,
playback timer, ads, account, microphone access, or tracking.

* Six mix levels each for high, mid and low frequencies
* Independent stereo or mono, saved App Loudness, smooth fades and peak protection
* Background playback and Lock Screen/media controls
* Home Screen widget and Quick Settings tile
* Flowing infinity artwork, optional background ribbons, and a live spectrogram
* Off and static visual modes to reduce work and battery use

Calls, another app taking audio focus, operating-system restrictions, force-stop,
and device shutdown can interrupt playback. Keep listening volume comfortable;
digital peak protection is not a sound-pressure limit at your ears.

MIT licensed. Native Android interface and audio service; shared C audio engine
with the Apple and web apps. Developed with AI assistance.
